name: KernelVault Enterprise C++20 & Linux Driver Dev Container
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake libgtest-dev qt6-base-dev kmod linux-headers-generic cppcheck clang-format clang-tidy valgrind && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DBUILD_GUI=ON && cmake --build build --parallel
